title: Senior Software Engineer, Java
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>About The Team</strong></h3> <p>The Roku Enterprise Engineering team is at the forefront of building a robust, integrated, and scalable platform that powers critical business processes across the organization. As a cornerstone of Roku's corporate strategy, this team is instrumental in automating workflows across all Business Systems, including Supply Chain, Finance, Sales Operations, and Human Resources. By challenging traditional approaches to workflow automation, the team leverages cutting-edge Engineering practices and API-driven design to streamline internal processes, boost efficiency, and deliver innovative solutions.</p> <p>The team's expertise spans a wide range of technologies, including Java and Python-based MicroServices, AWS/GCP cloud backend systems, Big Data technologies like Hive and Spark, and modern Web applications. With a globally distributed presence across the US, India and Europe, the team thrives on collaboration, bringing together diverse perspectives to solve complex challenges. At the heart of their success is a shared commitment to technical excellence, creativity, a strong sense of ownership, and a collaborative spirit that drives impactful results for Roku's business operations.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>About The Role</strong></h3> <p>As a senior technical lead, you consider yourself a platform services developer and developing innovative solutions using modern software frameworks and paradigms. You are self-driven and problem solver, with a strong background in building large-scale software platform and applications. You are execution focused and would develop a reputation for repeatedly delivering projects on-time.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design, develop and deploy scalable web applications and services, being part of everything from contributing to web technology and framework stack, to use case and data model design</li> <li>Drive architecture discussions, take ownership and responsibility over new projects, and deliver high quality software with tight timeline</li> <li>Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure the application meets compliance, security and audit requirements</li> <li>Participate in the continual improvement of engineering tools, cloud-based technologies/services, and process</li> <li>Define and participate in Agile development process, including scoping, technical design, estimation effort, coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, maintenance and support</li> <li>Collaborate with cross-function teams and demonstrate great communication skills</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3><strong>We're excited if you have</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in delivery multi-tier, highly scalable, distributed web application</li> <li>Deep understanding in software architecture, object-oriented design principles, and data structures</li> <li>Extensive experience in developing microservices using Java, Python</li> <li>Good experience in Test driven development and automating test cases using Java/ Python</li> <li>Experience in SQL / NoSQL (Oracle, Cassandra) database design</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to be proactive, self-driven, and make practical trade-offs based on business needs, entrepreneurial spirit</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills</li> <li>BS or MS degree in Computer Science or equivalent</li> <li>Experience in distributed computing frameworks like - Hive/Hadoop, Apache Spark</li> <li>Experience in developing Finance or HR related applications</li> <li>Experience with following cloud services: AWS Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, DynamoDB, VPC, Elastic Cache, Lambda</li> <li>Working experience with Terraform</li> <li>Experience in creating workflows for Apache Airflow</li> </ul> <h6>#LI-GL1</h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing <a ----- ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Regional Director, Unstructured Data Product Line Sales – EMEA & APJ
description: <p><strong>About Team & About Role</strong><br><br>Rubrik's sales organization helps hospitals, banks, schools and government agencies stay resilient against cyberattacks, malicious insiders and operational disruption, and unstructured data on NAS is one of the fastest-growing and most exposed corners of the data estate. As Regional Director for NAS Cloud Direct, you'll build and lead the team of Product Line Specialists who own this number across your region, and you'll set the standard for how Rubrik wins in this market. You'll work hand in hand with Core Account Executives, Sales Engineering, Sales Development, Channel Development and our partners within the One Rubrik selling motion, with the enablement, autonomy and ownership to take your team, your career and your earnings as far as your results allow. You'll also be the consolidated voice of the field and the customer back to Product Management, Product Marketing and PnP.<br><br><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own bookings growth and quota attainment for NAS Cloud Direct across the region, building a regional plan that helps more organizations protect massive volumes of unstructured data without adding on-prem backup infrastructure</li> <li>Recruit, hire, coach and develop a team of NAS Cloud Direct Sales Specialists, raising the bar on daily pipeline generation, net new logo acquisition and expansion within the existing Rubrik base</li> <li>Lead from the front on strategic opportunities, joining key deals and guiding your team through complex data center and cloud design conversations and CxO-level selling</li> <li>Run a disciplined forecast and weekly operating rhythm, using MEDDPICC and COtM to keep pipeline honest and give leadership a number they can plan around</li> <li>Align with regional leaders in Core AE, Sales Engineering, Sales Development and Channel Development on coverage and account strategy, so specialists and Core AEs win together rather than compete for the same deal</li> <li>Build repeatable, partner-led momentum with distributors, resellers and VARs, turning co-sell relationships into a growing share of regional pipeline</li> <li>Champion NAS Cloud Direct inside and outside Rubrik, enabling the field on positioning, objection handling and competitive differentiation so more teams can sell it with confidence</li> <li>Bring market and customer feedback to Product Management and Product Marketing, shaping what we build next and how we take it to market, and share what's working with fellow Product Line Specialist leaders so the whole organization learns faster</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience You'll Need</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years leading quota-carrying field sales teams in technology, with a record of consistently overachieving as a leader and as a seller</li> <li>Experience selling or leading sales of data protection, storage, cloud infrastructure or NAS-related solutions into enterprise and mid-enterprise accounts</li> <li>A track record of building pipeline across many accounts and verticals and landing net new logos, and of coaching others to do the same</li> <li>Comfort guiding sellers as they position a technical product in complex data center and cloud environments and build champions with technical and business buyers</li> <li>Experience working with channel partners, distributors and resellers to co-sell and grow a territory</li> <li>Forecasting discipline, a structured approach to deal qualification, and experience recruiting and developing high-performing sellers</li> <li>Strong written, verbal and presentation skills, and the ability to influence peers, executives and cross-functional partners in sensitive situations</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exposure to unstructured data challenges and enterprise NAS platforms</li> <li>Experience leading product-specialist or overlay sales teams alongside Core AE organizations</li> <li>Familiarity with the competitive landscape in data protection and cloud storage</li> <li>Working knowledge of MEDDPICC for sales qualification and the COtM sales methodology</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2>Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation</h2> <p>Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.</p> <p><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/rubrik-inc/mycompany/verification/">Linkedin</a> | <a href="https://twitter.com/rubrikinc">X (formerly Twitter)</a> | <a href="https://www.instagram.com/rubrikinc/" target="_blank">Instagram</a> | <a href="https://www.rubrik.com">Rubrik.com</a></p> <h2>Inclusion @ Rubrik</h2> <p>At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.</p> <p>Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.</p> <h3>Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:</h3> <ul> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.</p> </li> <li> <p style="line-height: 1;">Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled</h2> <p>Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.</p> <p>Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. title: EMEA Platform Solution Architect
description: <p>The Rubrik Engineering team is comprised of people who produce extraordinary results. Our engineers are driven to build efficient, reliable, and cost-effective products. We believe in empowering our teams, giving engineers autonomy and responsibility, not just tasks. Our goal is to motivate and challenge you to do the best work of your career. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation About the Role Relay sells through two core motions. The first is our new-business engine: a B2B enterprise sales motion winning large retailers and brands with significant parcel volumes — and, in time, extending down-market into Small medium enterprises (SME) as that segment opens up. The second is our field engine, which grows Relay's network of "Pitstops" — local shops and businesses that act as pick-up and drop-off points where consumers can collect parcels and return items. Both motions depend on the systems and processes this role will build and own: the account universe and TAM, lead scoring and prioritisation, outreach, CRM architecture, governance, and sales tooling. You'll be both architect and operator, and AI-native in how you work. You'll define what great looks like across the systems and processes underpinning both sales motions, then take ownership of making it happen. You’ll also be highly fluent in metrics — using dashboards and funnel data to identify where performance is breaking down, where opportunities are being lost, and where we can drive greater efficiency. What You'll Do Build the new-business engine: own TAM, account scoring and weekly prioritisation, plus a top-of-funnel (enrichment, multi-threaded contacts, sequencing, signal-based triggers) that lets sales spend their time pitching, not hunting. Own the CRM and deal desk: architect Pipedrive around the selling rhythm, govern deal terms, stages and approval gates from pitch to activation, and raise the quality and speed of pitches and proposals. Scale the Pitstop engine: run the field team's scoring, territories, targets and dashboards, manage pricing levers and CPA, and keep lead-to-live data clean, pushing toward a self-running engine with algorithmic assignment, referrals and AI-handled inbound. Automate relentlessly: own the tooling stack and build-vs-buy calls (defaulting to building), strip manual work out of the sales day, and design systems that extend to SME and self-serve through configuration, not a rebuild. Diagnose and fix the funnel: use funnel data to find where deals stall and pipeline leaks, then ship the fixes. Who Will Thrive in This Role Systems thinker. You build systems rather than one-off fixes, and you take ideas all the way to a shipped, working solution yourself. Proven RevOps experience. You've run sales or revenue operations in a fast-moving environment and know what best-in-class looks like across top-of-funnel, CRM, deal desk and process. CRM owner, not just admin. You've implemented and evolved Pipedrive (or similar) so it fits the selling motion, rather than bending the motion to fit the tool. Native AI builder. You're fluent with Claude and have shipped real tooling and automations in a live business. Fast, practical delivery. You implement quickly and are comfortable scoping work for engineering when you need their help. High bar for quality. You insist on clean data and tight processes Equally strong in detail and with people. You're comfortable refining a workflow in depth and equally at ease talking pipeline quality with sales. Compensation, Benefits & Workplace Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it 25 days of holidays Enhanced parental leave Hardware of your choice Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more) Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously. Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction. 1% Better Every Day : You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience. All In, All the Time : You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect. title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST. We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application. About the role We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will: Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination). Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance. Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature. Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure. Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas. Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols. Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services. Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy. Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails. To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more! What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure. A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs. Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources. Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning. Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka. Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based). AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment. Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two. The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement. Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments. Why is this role a good fit for you This role is a good fit for you if: You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers. You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements. You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering. This role is not a good fit for you if: You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy. You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team. You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them. How you’ll develop in this role In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will: Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised. Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it. Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary. Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations. Show me the benefits Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!) Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis. 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards). For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options. We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work The interview process We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows: Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills. Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application: We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background. Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process. This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas. About your application English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us. A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails. Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us. Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you. Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here . Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role. Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. The Role This is our first Director of Employee Relations & Compliance for EMEA: a senior, hands-on role owning ER casework, employment law compliance and jurisdictional risk across Germany, the UK, Sweden, Italy, Spain and France. Based in London, you'll be the standing authority on ER practice in the region. You'll own complex casework end to end, build dedicated ER capability where none exists today, and extend the strength we already have in Stockholm. You'll report to the EMEA People Director, with a path to running an independent function reporting to the CHRO as it scales. What You'll Do ER leadership and casework Own complex casework end to end across every market: investigations, grievances, disciplinaries, PIPs and terminations for cause, to a consistently high, legally sound standard. Be the escalation point when a matter turns complex, contested or legally weighted, for Local People Advisory and the wider People org. Hold the bar on case handling: written scoping, contemporaneous documentation, balance-of-probabilities findings, and independent second review of any outcome that could end employment. Compliance and jurisdictional risk Own employment and ER compliance across all six markets: statutory notice and consultation, works council and union engagement, mandatory filings and register-keeping, and local implementation of the EU Whistleblowing Directive (disclosures run through a separate channel). Maintain the EMEA jurisdiction playbook and horizon-scan for legal changes, flagging implications to leadership early. Engage Employment Counsel at the right moment with a clear written scope, not as a late rescue. Note: comp-related compliance (pay equity, gender pay gap, benefits) sits with Rewards. Team and capability building Build dedicated ER capability across EMEA, prioritised by risk and case volume, on the foundation of the Stockholm team. Certify and calibrate anyone running a formal ER process, keeping casework consistent as the team grows. Stakeholder partnership and consistency Act as the quality check for Local People Advisory across EMEA (who sit in People Operations), signing off local ER and compliance work without managing those roles day to day. Partner with People Partners, People Operations, People Tech and Rewards so policy and tooling reflect what EMEA markets need. Turn case patterns into a regular, actionable view for People leadership. Work with your NORAM and APAC counterparts on one shared case taxonomy, system and calibration forum, representing EMEA's regulatory and cultural nuance in global standards. What You'll Bring Significant experience leading ER, HR compliance or similar at a fast-scaling company, ideally across multiple EMEA jurisdictions. Deep, practical knowledge of employment law and ER practice across several of these markets, and comfort working outside your home jurisdiction. A track record of investigations, disciplinaries and terminations that hold up to scrutiny: calm, neutral and thorough under pressure. Experience building an ER or compliance function from the ground up: process, hiring, and getting a distributed team to one standard. Confidence as a senior, independent voice, comfortable escalating to and influencing leadership. Based in or willing to relocate to London, able to travel across EMEA. What Success Looks Like Every formal ER matter across the region handled fairly, consistently and to a legally sound standard. A resourced, capable EMEA ER team, built out from London to the markets that need it. The wider People org treats this function as the standing authority on ER and compliance, not a bottleneck. A function ready to stand on its own, with a credible case for direct CHRO reporting. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start: One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK Profitable since 2017 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot ) So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days. We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. Join us if you want to Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting About the role We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up. Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment. You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets. Standalone direct mail roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role. What we’re looking for: Essential: 5+ years in direct mail, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results. A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for. Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost. Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased). A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed. Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions. Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule. The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates. Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams. A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams. Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow. Desirable: Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting. Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data) Experience building a channel or function from scratch Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team You’re a good fit if you’re: Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones. Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone. A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines. Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s What you’ll be doing Strategy and commercials Own the direct mail strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV. Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline. Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics. Data and targeting Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data. Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when. Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value. Campaigns and supplier management Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats. Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround. Brief the creative team on packs, copy and offers, and take them through compliance sign-off. Reporting & Team Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance Partner with data, product, risk, finance and the creative team to unlock targeting and offers Hire and develop the team as the channel scales, and use AI to let a small team punch above its weight Life at Lendable Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. title: Senior solutions architect (UK)
description: 🚀 About WRITER WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance. Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com . 📐 About the role Every company grows differently, and at WRITER, our growth is directly tied to empowering our users to create better content, faster, and at an unprecedented scale. As a strategic solutions architect, you'll be at the forefront of this mission, working directly with our largest and most strategic prospects to identify, validate, and build innovative generative AI solutions that unlock massive business value. This isn't just about selling a product; it's about deeply understanding complex enterprise needs and architecting a future where AI transforms how our customers operate. You'll be instrumental in shaping how the world's leading companies adopt and scale AI, making a tangible impact on both their success and WRITER’s continued leadership in the enterprise generative AI space. This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our London hub. You will report directly to the Director of solutions architecture. 🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do Drive strategic technical discovery with Fortune 500 prospects and customers, translating complex business challenges into clear, impactful technical solutions for AI-powered work Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure generative AI solutions for enterprise clients, leveraging WRITER's platform, APIs, and custom applications to solve critical business problems Lead the development and execution of compelling proofs of concept (PoCs) and demonstrations, building custom templates and integrating WRITER's capabilities to showcase transformative value and accelerate time-to-value for customers Serve as a trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives, VPs of Engineering, and AI leaders, guiding their generative AI strategy and collaborating to define enterprise-level architecture roadmaps Partner closely with WRITER's product and engineering teams, providing critical feedback from customer engagements to influence our product roadmap and ensure our solutions meet evolving market needs Champion the adoption of WRITER's platform and APIs, educating prospects and partners on the art of the possible with generative AI and empowering them to build their own innovative solutions ⭐️ What you need 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as solutions architect, enterprise architect, or sales engineering, ideally within a high-growth, B2B SaaS company serving Fortune 500 clients Deep expertise in generative AI principles, large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering best practices, with a passion for staying ahead of the curve in this rapidly evolving field Experience in Python, proficiency with APIs, and end-to-end orchestration, to augment AI workflows and integrate AI capabilities into complex enterprise systems Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to simplify complex technical concepts into clear, compelling business language for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership A highly versatile and tenured problem solver, capable of leading multi-stakeholder discovery sessions, uncovering root causes, and architecting innovative solutions to complex business and technical challenges A builder's mindset and a proven ability to connect deeply with customer needs, challenge the status quo with innovative AI solutions, and own the technical success and impact of client engagements 🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees): Generous PTO, plus company holidays Before board and investor meetings, you’ll make sure they know the numbers and what’s in the board pack. You’re super organised, and can juggle requests coming in from multiple people with different ways of working. You’re trustworthy and reliable. You have exceptional attention to detail. Come join us.</p></div><h4><strong>The opportunity:</strong></h4> <p>The Enterprise Account Executive (ENT) is responsible for driving complex, high-value enterprise deals and establishing long-term strategic partnerships with large customers. Design evaluation and monitoring approaches that make quality, reliability and safety measurable rather than assumed. Build AI applications and agents using LLMs, orchestration, APIs and data systems, applying solid production software practices throughout. Make the calls on models, cost and latency that shape what a feature costs us to run, and document the reasoning so others can follow it. Prototype quickly, work out what is reusable, and harden the patterns that work into components the rest of the team adopts. You've invested deliberately in your software engineering craft: testing, error handling, CI/CD, observability, and the MLOps practices that keep things healthy once they're live. You're hands-on across the GenAI stack: LLM APIs, retrieval and vector stores, agents with tool use, and structured outputs, running on cloud infrastructure (we use AWS and GCP). You have a real point of view on evaluation, most likely because you've been caught out by a system that looked fine and wasn't. You get satisfaction from the unglamorous work that makes an AI feature actually good, not just the part that demos well. You can disagree well, and commit once a decision is made. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":279}"> </span></p></div><p><strong>Life at THG Beauty </strong></p> <p>We know that beauty isn’t one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.</p> <p>By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.</p> <p>THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. </p> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> Cult Beauty</span></strong></p> <p>Cult Beauty is one of the UK's leading online beauty destinations, known for a curated, expert-led edit of the best emerging and established beauty brands. As part of THG, Cult Beauty combines an entrepreneurial, fast-moving culture with the scale, data and technology of a global e-commerce group. The affiliates and partnerships channel is a genuine growth priority for the business, with strong performance to date and significant headroom to scale reach, revenue and brand awareness over the next 12–24 months.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Why be a Senior Paid Social Manager at THG Beauty?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p>The Senior Paid Social Manager is responsible for developing and executing Cult Beauty’s paid social strategy to drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention. This role involves day-to-day management of paid social campaigns, budget ownership, and performance optimization across key platforms like Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest.</p> <p>Working closely with Brand and Ecommerce teams, the Senior Paid Social Manager ensures that paid social activities are aligned with commercial priorities and deliver against key business objectives. This role is ideal for an experienced paid social specialist looking to take on greater strategic responsibility, budget ownership, and stakeholder engagement.</p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As<strong> Senior Paid Media Manager</strong></span><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>,</strong> you’ll: </span><span data-ccp-props="{"335551550":1,"335551620":1}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Budget & Forecasting: </strong>Day-to-day management of the paid social budget, including forecasting and reporting in partnership with the Digital Director.</li> <li><strong>Strategy Development: </strong>The development and delivery of the paid social strategy across all key platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Pinterest).</li> <li><strong>Campaign Lifecycle: </strong>End-to-end campaign management, from planning and setup to optimization, testing, and analysis.</li> <li><strong>Partner Relationships: </strong>Relationships with key social media platform partners, staying ahead of new features, best practices, and investment opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Performance Insights: </strong>Reporting and insights on paid social performance to inform investment decisions and strategic planning.</li> <li><strong>Measurement Frameworks: </strong>Adoption and utilization of measurement and attribution platforms to demonstrate the value and impact of paid social activities.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What skills and experience do I need for this role?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559685":0,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <h2>1. <span style="font-size: 12pt;">Paid Social Strategy & Planning</span></h2> <ul> <li>Develop and implement a comprehensive paid social strategy aligned with Cult Beauty’s overall marketing and business goals.</li> <li>Plan and execute both always-on and campaign-specific activities across all relevant paid social channels.</li> <li>Ensure paid social plans are aligned with the trading calendar, new brand launches, and promotional activities.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Brand team to ensure creative assets are best-in-class and optimized for each platform.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">2. Budget Management & Forecasting</span></h2> <ul> <li>Manage the paid social marketing budget, tracking spend against the plan and identifying risks or opportunities.</li> <li>Own in-month and in-quarter forecasting of paid social spend and performance metrics.</li> <li>Provide evidence-led recommendations for budget allocation based on channel performance and strategic priorities.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">3. Campaign Management & Optimisation</span></h2> <ul> <li>Manage day-to-day campaign execution, including audience targeting, creative setup, and bidding strategies.</li> <li>Continuously monitor and optimize campaigns to meet performance targets such as ROAS, CPA, and LTV.</li> <li>Champion a robust test-and-learn approach, running A/B tests on creative, copy, and targeting to drive continuous improvement.</li> <li>Analyze performance data to generate actionable insights and recommendations for future campaigns.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">4. Platform & External Partnerships</span></h2> <ul> <li>Build and maintain strong relationships with key platform partners, including Meta, TikTok, and Pinterest.</li> <li>Stay informed about new ad formats, platform updates, and emerging trends to keep Cult Beauty at the forefront of paid social innovation.</li> <li>Identify and explore new platform opportunities to expand reach and drive growth.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">5. Stakeholder, Peer & SLT Relationships</span></h2> <ul> <li>Act as the key paid social contact for internal teams, including Ecommerce, Brand, and Creative.</li> <li>Build strong working relationships with peers across the marketing function to ensure an integrated approach.</li> <li>Confidently present performance updates, insights, and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">6. Measurement & Attribution</span></h2> <ul> <li>Utilize attribution and marketing mix modelling (MMM) outputs to understand the true impact of paid social and optimize spend accordingly.</li> <li>Work with the wider marketing team to ensure a consistent approach to measurement and reporting.</li> <li>Translate complex data into clear, practical recommendations for channel and budget optimization.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">7. Reporting, Insight & Continuous Improvement</span></h2> <ul> <li>Own regular reporting on paid social performance, budgets, and core KPIs.</li> <li>Translate performance data into clear, actionable insights for the Digital Director and the wider business.</li> <li>Stay current with industry trends and best practices, bringing new ideas into the team to foster innovation.</li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What Success Looks Like</span></h1> <ul> <li><strong>Target Delivery: </strong>Paid social budget delivered within agreed COS/ROAS targets, with accurate and confident forecasting.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional Collaboration: </strong>Strong, trusted relationships with internal teams that ensure paid social is fully integrated with wider business activities.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Partnerships: </strong>Platform partnerships that provide Cult Beauty with early access to new features and strong commercial terms.</li> <li><strong>Data-driven Decisions: </strong>Clear, evidence-led investment decisions that drive growth in customer acquisition and retention.</li> <li><strong>Innovation: </strong>A robust test-and-learn culture that leads to continuous performance improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What’s in it for me?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Career Development</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"201341983":0,"335551550":1,"335551620":1,"335559737":0,"335559738":0,"335559739":160,"335559740":279}"> </span></p> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="18" data-list-defn-props="{"33555254

title: Head of Product - B2B
description: About us At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels. Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄 We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels. Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet. We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel. Introducing the Trainline Partner Solutions Team 👋 Trainline Partner Solutions (TPS) is building the world's number one rail platform - giving partners everything they need to grow rail by making it simpler to access, sell, service, and scale, so more travellers choose rail with confidence. TPS powers the technology that enables Travel Management Companies (TMCs), Online Booking Tools (OBTs), and other distribution partners across the UK and Europe to sell and manage rail travel seamlessly. This role sits at the heart of that mission, leading the product strategy for TPS Distribution within B2B. Reporting into the Product Director, you will own the product vision and P&L accountability for distribution, working in close partnership with Sales and Account Management to maximise revenue from existing partners and identify new commercial opportunities. Your key stakeholders span Data Science, UX, Engineering, and Commercial Finance, and you will lead a team of four Product Managers, with direct line management responsibility for three of them. In this role as the Head of Product - TPS Distribution, you will... 🚄 Own the end-to-end product vision and roadmap for TPS Distribution, ensuring it is grounded in partner value, commercial outcomes, and long-term platform health across the UK and European markets. Take accountability for the distribution P&L, using data and commercial insight to prioritise what gets built, when, and why - balancing revenue growth with partner retention. Work closely with the Sales and Account Management organisation to ensure product strategy actively supports partner acquisition, retention, and revenue performance. Lead, coach, and develop a team of Product Managers, building strong product craft, clear ownership, and a high standard of execution across the portfolio. We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe. We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale. We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. title: VP Sales
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Your Role We are seeking a VP Sales to lead new business development with government and large space sector customers. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thrives on winning major contracts personally, not just directing a team from a distance. You bring deep, current knowledge of the satellite sales landscape, a track record of closing significant contracts, and the seniority to represent NewOrbit at the highest level with strategic customers. Key Responsibilities Win and close contracts: Lead high-value deals with governments and large space organisations, from first conversation through to signature. Own the full sales cycle: Sourcing, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close - across every stage. Build strategic relationships: Develop and maintain senior-level relationships across government agencies, primes, and major operators. Set commercial strategy: Shape and execute NewOrbit's sales approach for government and enterprise customers. Represent NewOrbit externally: Executive-level presence at customer meetings, government engagements, and industry events. Partner internally: Work closely with engineering and delivery teams to scope deals that are commercially sound and deliverable. Report to leadership: Own pipeline, forecasting, and deal status reporting to the board. Grow the function: Build out a wider sales team as the business scales. Fundamental Requirements Satellite sales experience (required): Direct, hands-on experience selling satellites specifically, across the full sales process. Current, up-to-date knowledge of the satellite customer landscape. Deal track record: Demonstrated history of winning significant (single-digit million £) contracts with large space organizations and/or governments. Seniority: Minimum 10 years in space industry sales; realistically 15-20+ years. This is a senior hire. Career focus: Majority, ideally the entirety, of your career spent in the space industry. Relationship-led approach: A strong, established professional network across government, primes, and major operators, built through years of direct engagement in the sector. Why NewOrbit Space? Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO. Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology. Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups. Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week. Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
description: Our mission We're making Africa the first cashless continent. In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash. We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast. Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in... How you'll help us achieve it Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale. Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be. AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt. We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use. In this role, you'll... Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users. Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way. Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward. Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all. Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you. Key Details This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy. Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product. Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package. Major benefits: Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country). 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance. Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. $10,000 annual charitable donation matching. Requirement 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups. Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost. AI-fluent: you've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments. Speak fluent English Bonus if you Speak at least conversational French Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear. Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance) Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa You might be a good fit if you Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way. Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence. Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures. Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience. Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable. Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle. Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives. Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact. Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential. About Product at Wave Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago. Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave! If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here. If that's you, we'd love to meet you. Our team We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world. We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most. We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production. We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa. We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue . How to apply Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role. We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals. Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
