title: Principal Consultant (Enterprise Modernisation Architect)
description: <div class="description content"> <p>The Solution architect for Enterprise Modernization in Europe is a senior subject matter expert responsible for technical excellence, solution integrity, and capability development within the service line.</p> <p>This hands-on role leads high-impact client engagements, contributes to pre-sales and solution design, and ensures the regional adoption and evolution of service-specific delivery frameworks, tools, and best practices. The role brings deep expertise in modernization strategies and execution in large legacy systems modernization programs, serving as a trusted technical advisor to both clients and internal teams. This role is key to ensuring delivery quality, enabling service adoption, and evolving the technical maturity of the offering.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li>Provides technical guidance on Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Supports delivery teams in solving complex client problems.</li> <li>Contributes to solution design, proposals, and pre-sales activities.</li> <li>Develops and refines service accelerators and reference architectures.</li> <li>Mentors engineers and architects within the service domain.</li> <li>Acts as a bridge between delivery teams and global service development.</li> <li>Measures success by technical quality, asset adoption, and talent uplift.</li> <li>Requires 10+ years of experience in software engineering or technical consulting.</li> <li>Requires 3+ years in Enterprise Systems Modernization advisory.</li> <li>Focuses on technical depth in modernization strategies and enterprise solution architecture.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <br> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Experience supporting solution design and technical delivery in complex enterprise environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to build, extend, and support delivery tools, frameworks, and reusable assets.</li> <li>Deep technical expertise in modernization strategies, cloud architecture, and platform thinking.</li> <li>Strong engineering skills, architecture patterns knowledge, and toolchain understanding.</li> <li>Excellent communication to translate technical insights into actionable business decisions.</li> <li>Collaborative with mentorship abilities and solution-oriented with asset contribution commitment.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3>           <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>10+ years in software engineering, platform delivery, or technical consulting roles.</li> <li>3+ years in a subject matter expert or senior technical advisory role within Enterprise Systems Modernization.</li> <li>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.</li> <li>Certifications in relevant platforms, tools, or frameworks for the Enterprise Systems Modernization domain.</li> <li>Experience contributing to internal accelerators, open-source projects, or client-aligned IP development.</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise transformation programs and the consulting delivery lifecycle.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff System Software Engineer
description: <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>Build the test strategy that protects Graphcore’s system software releases at scale.</p> <p>As a Staff System Software Engineer, you will shape integration and system testing across firmware, BMC and Linux device drivers. Your work will help create a high quality gate for system software release packages.</p> <p>You will design, build, automate and report tests across complex server class systems. You will also develop reusable tools, pipelines and packaging solutions that help teams move faster with confidence.</p> <p>This role needs deep low level software knowledge and strong system thinking. You will own hard technical areas, guide best practice and stay close to the code.</p> <p><strong>The team and culture</strong></p> <p>You will join a new integration and system test team within System Software QA. The team verifies integrated components across BMC, firmware and Linux device drivers.</p> <p>Work happens close to the hardware, across component teams and QA. You will partner with developers, consult package stakeholders and turn use cases into robust system tests.</p> <p>Decisions are shaped by evidence, clear technical reasoning and ownership. You will be expected to speak up, act fast and raise standards through hands-on leadership.</p> <p><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p>· Strong experience in low level system testing and integration across complex software and hardware layers.<br>· Deep understanding of RTOS, complex boot logic, Linux and device drivers.<br>· Test development capability using Python and C/C++.<br>· Experience working with hardware, debuggers, CI/CD pipelines and build or integration tools.<br>· Ability to debug cross-layer issues and drive root-cause investigations to lasting corrective actions.<br>· Clear communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and document complex technical decisions.</p> <p>While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility<br>· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work<br>· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension<br>· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success<br>· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day<br>· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones<br>· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover<br>· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</p> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.<br>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</p> <p><strong>Sponsorship</strong></p> <p>Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</p> <p><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></p> <p>Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</p> <p>Ready to build the tests, tools and release gates that help Graphcore deliver trusted system software? Apply now to join the team.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Cloud Engineer
description: <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the job</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;" data-start="150" data-end="238"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Build the cloud platform that turns Graphcore AI systems into usable, scalable services.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;" data-start="240" data-end="484"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Graphcore needs a Staff Cloud Engineer to develop and deploy private and public cloud services for AI compute. You will join the Cloud Platform team within Software Platform, close to datacentre operations and product development.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;" data-start="486" data-end="698"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Your work will shape how internal users and customers access large-scale AI systems. title: Principal Cloud Engineer
description: <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the job</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Build the cloud platform that powers Graphcore’s next generation AI systems.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">As a Principal Cloud Engineer, you will help develop, deploy and operate cloud services across Graphcore’s AI infrastructure. You will work on private and public cloud systems used by internal teams and customers.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Your work will shape how high-performance AI systems are integrated, validated, benchmarked and optimised. You will help keep complex infrastructure reliable, observable and ready for demanding workloads.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">You will own significant technical initiatives, from OpenStack-based services to Infrastructure-as-Code automation. You will also mentor engineers and turn user needs into services that perform at scale.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">This role puts you close to pre-release hardware, advanced systems and real product challenges.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"> </p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>The Team and Culture</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The Cloud Platform Team sits within Software Platform and works closely with Software Platform, Datacentre Operations and Product Development. The team builds systems for internal users and customers, often using new components before they are proven.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Work moves through practical engineering, clear ownership and fast feedback from users. You will be expected to take responsibility, speak up early and lead critical infrastructure work without close oversight.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Decisions are grounded in evidence from benchmarks, observability data and operational performance. The team values engineers who can think big, act fast and bring others with them.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"> </p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant subject.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strong infrastructure or IT background, with private-cloud or on-premises cloud experience.</strong></span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Expert Linux system administration and scripting skills, including bash and Python.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform/OpenTofu, Ansible or Packer.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience with CI or testing pipelines, version control and cloud service deployment.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Strong communication skills, with the judgement to lead critical work and support end users.</span></li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. If you meet most of our essential criteria, we encourage you to submit an application and showcase how your background makes you a strong candidate.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"> </p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Benefits</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Generous leave:</strong> Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Retirement planning support:</strong> Up to 5% matched pension</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Phantom equity: </strong>Share in Graphcore’s success</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Workplace experience:</strong> Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Peace of mind protection:</strong> Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Flexible benefits:</strong> Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Optional benefits:</strong> Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn</span></li> </ul> <p style="line-height: 1;"> </p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</span><br><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"> </p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Sponsorship</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"> </p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Join the Team at Graphcore</strong></span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">If you want to build the cloud platform behind Graphcore’s next generation AI systems, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now to be part of the journey.</span></p> <p style="line-height: 1;"> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Director, Post-Silicon Validation
description: <p>Graphcore is a globally recognized leader in Artificial Intelligence computing systems. The company designs advanced semiconductors and datacentre hardware that provide the specialized processing power needed to drive AI innovation, while delivering the efficiency required to support its broader adoption.</p> <p>As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, we are working to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure that its benefits are accessible to everyone.</p> <p>We are developing the next generation of AI compute, a large-scale system-on-chip (SoC) designed to power future high-performance AI systems. As the Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will be responsible for leading the Bristol team, enabling pre-production software to run reliably on new silicon quickly and efficiently, before showing that the silicon meets the highest standards of quality, reliability and functionality, ready for production deployment.</p> <p>Reporting to the Senior Director of Post Silicon Validation, you will manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol, delivering post-silicon validation across the full AI SoC, working across silicon, firmware, and platform levels. The role requires a deep technical understanding, strong hands-on debug experience, and the ability to collaborate effectively with hardware, software, and systems engineering teams.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage, develop and grow the Post Silicon Validation team in Bristol: </strong>The Post Silicon Validation team is relatively new, with a strong remit and growing quickly to help Graphcore bring up new silicon quickly and effectively.</li> <li><strong>Play a significant role in the definition, planning and execution of chip bringup activities: </strong>Develop and refine the overall post-silicon validation approach for our AI SoCs, ensuring reliable and timely delivery of validated silicon, architectural correctness, feature robustness, and at-scale system reliability.</li> <li><strong>Drive cross-domain debug and issue resolution: </strong>Lead investigation and resolution of complex issues spanning silicon, firmware, operating systems, and platform interactions. Ensure that fixes are effective and sustainable.</li> <li><strong>Promote collaboration and shared understanding: </strong>Work closely with design, software, and validation teams to align on quality objectives and debug priorities. Use data-driven insights and clear communication to maintain focus and alignment across teams.</li> <li><strong>Advance automation and scalable validation: </strong>Encourage the use of emulation, prototyping, and large-scale validation infrastructure to improve coverage and reduce time to debug.</li> <li><strong>Support continuous improvement: </strong>Foster a culture that values learning, transparency, and improvement in validation methods, automation, and analysis.</li> <li><strong>Engage with leadership and partners: </strong>Provide clear and concise updates on validation progress, risks, and quality indicators to executive teams and key partners. Contribute to product readiness assessments and roadmap decisions</li> </ul> <p><strong>Essential skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Building and running high performing teams</li> <li>A systems thinker, comfortable working across hardware, software, and integration boundaries</li> <li>A collaborative leader who builds trust and alignment across diverse teams</li> <li>Skilled in technical problem solving and debugging complex post-silicon issues</li> <li>A clear communicator who can simplify complexity and support sound decision-making in fast-paced environments</li> <li>Committed to developing people and promoting an inclusive, high-performing team culture</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Electronic Engineering or equivalent; Master’s preferred</li> <li>20+ years in silicon, system, or platform validation, including 10+ years in technical leadership</li> <li>Proven experience leading post-silicon validation and bring-up for complex SoCs (AI, GPU, or CPU)</li> <li>Strong understanding of SoC architecture, coherency protocols, power management, and interconnects</li> <li>Expertise in debug tools, DFT infrastructure, and validation automation frameworks</li> <li>Proficient in C/C++, Python, and Linux-based environments; experience with large-scale validation clusters is an advantage</li> </ul> <p>Benefits</p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, Graphcore offers flexible working, a generous annual leave policy, private medical insurance and health cash plan, a dental plan, pension, life assurance and income protection. We have a generous parental leave policy and an employee assistance programme (which includes health, mental wellbeing, and bereavement support). We welcome people of different backgrounds and experiences; we’re committed to building an inclusive work environment that makes Graphcore a great home for everyone. We offer an equal opportunity process and understand that there are visible and invisible differences in all of us. We can provide a flexible approach to interview and encourage you to chat to us if you require any reasonable adjustments.</p> <p> </p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Research Engineer
description: <h3><strong>About Graphcore</strong></h3> <p><span data-teams="true">At Graphcore, we’re building the future of AI compute.We’re a team of semiconductor, software and AI experts, with deep experience in creating the complete AI compute stack - from silicon and software to infrastructure at datacenter scale.As part of the SoftBank Group, backed by significant long-term investment, we are delivering key technology into the fast-growing SoftBank AI ecosystem.To meet the vast and exciting AI opportunity, Graphcore is expanding its teams around the world.We are bringing together the brightest minds to solve the toughest problems, in a place where everyone has the opportunity to make an impact on the company, our products and the future of artificial intelligence.</span></p> <h3>Job Summary</h3> <p class="p1">As a research engineer at Graphcore, you will contribute to the advancement of AI research, investigating new ideas that push the limits on important AI/ML problems. Specialised hardware has been the key driver of the progress of AI over the last decade, and we believe that hardware-aware AI algorithms and AI-aware hardware developments will continue to be critical to advancing this exciting field. We are therefore looking for individuals who combine strong machine learning experience with practical engineering skills to deliver impactful AI research. We are seeking AI researchers with strong software engineering experience, particularly in lower-level programming and performance optimisation for hardware efficiency. Our research spans a broad range of topics, including efficient training and inference, world models, life sciences, reinforcement learning, and beyond. You will work closely with researchers to generate ideas and translate them into scalable implementations, contributing to publications and projects that help to steer the future of AI hardware.</p> <p> </p> <h3>The Team</h3> <p>Graphcore Research participates in both fundamental and applied research, to characterise the computational requirements of machine intelligence and to demonstrate how hardware can drive the next generation of innovative AI models. We publish at leading AI/ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) as well as specialist workshops, and collaborate with other research teams and organisations across the world.</p> <p>We pride ourselves on being a supportive and collaborative team, where we organise around our individual research interests to solve problems together in domains such as efficient compute, model scaling and distributed training and inference of AI models for multiple modalities and applications, including for sequence- and graph-based data. We’re based across London, Cambridge and Bristol, with projects and discussions that involve all our locations.</p> <p>Perhaps the best way to get an idea of what we’re all about is to read one of our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/publications/">papers</a> or an article on our <a href="https://graphcore-research.github.io/posts/">blog</a>. If you’re excited to work at the cutting edge of AI supported by new hardware and want to develop your skills in this area, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <h3>Responsibilities and Duties</h3> to internal teams by designing experiments and delivering clear, actionable reports.</li> <li>Collaborate with researchers, silicon and software engineers at Graphcore to help define, build and test Graphcore’s next generation of AI hardware.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>About you:</h3> <p>Essential:</p> <ul> <li> Master’s, PhD or equivalent experience in a technical discipline (e.g., Maths, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry).</li> <li>Python programming in a modern deep learning framework, e.g. PyTorch or JAX.</li> <li>Familiar with deep learning fundamentals: models, optimisation, evaluation and scaling.</li> <li>Capable of designing, executing and reporting from ML experiments.</li> <li>Lower-level programming for hardware efficiency, e.g. C++/CUDA/Triton.</li> Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h3><strong>About Fanatics Markets:</strong></h3> <p>Fanatics Markets is the real-money prediction and trading app where you can invest in moments you care about. Built on a secure platform, we let users predict real-world outcomes and trade on events they actually follow - from sports and entertainment to political elections and beyond. Our mission is to redefine how fans engage with the moments and markets that matter most. We're looking for the right people to help us build the future of prediction markets.<br><br><strong>Overview:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>Fanatics recently acquired a CFTC-registered Designated Contract Market and Derivatives Clearing Organisation, giving Fanatics Markets its own fully regulated exchange and clearinghouse infrastructure. We are now building the engineering team that will run it.</p> <p>This Senior Software Engineer (Backend) role sits at the heart of that build. You will have significant ownership over the core exchange platform, working on the systems that power order processing, market data distribution, trade lifecycle management and regulatory reporting for a CFTC-regulated exchange. The engineering challenges are those of any serious regulated trading environment, high-availability, low-latency, mission-critical infrastructure, but built for a consumer audience with the reach and distribution of Fanatics behind it.</p> <p>You will be joining a team modernising an existing Java codebase and building new services in Java, working alongside engineers with deep backgrounds in regulated financial infrastructure. You will be joining a team with a clear ambition: to bring this platform to the bleeding edge of financial infrastructure. This is not a clean slate but the technical ambition is real, and engineers who join now will have a level of architectural influence and ownership that is hard to find anywhere else.</p> <p>We are pioneering the use of AI as a code collaborator. We need engineers who have gone beyond experimentation and who actively use Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to ship production code faster while maintaining exceptional quality standards.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of high-performance, fault-tolerant distributed backend services supporting the FMX exchange platform.</li> <li>Own services and features end-to-end: spec writing, implementation, instrumentation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration based on metrics.</li> <li>Work within and help modernise the existing Java codebase while contributing to new service development in Java and potentially Kotlin.</li> <li>Contribute to the architecture for order processing, market data distribution, and trade lifecycle management on a CFTC-regulated exchange.</li> <li>Build and maintain reliable daily reporting pipelines, ensuring data integrity and full audit trails across all trading activity.</li> <li>Participate in 24/7 on-call rotations, contribute to SLO definition, alerting strategy, and incident response for mission-critical trading infrastructure.</li> <li>Model and manage data for contracts, orders, positions, and settlements with an emphasis on correctness, integrity, and regulatory auditability.</li> <li>Collaborate with the DevOps/Platform team to ensure services are observable, scalable, and compliant with MNPI and insider trading restrictions.</li> <li>Conduct thorough code reviews, raising the bar on code quality, readability, security, and maintainability.</li> <li>Leverage AI tools to accelerate development velocity while maintaining high standards for security, correctness, and regulatory compliance.</li> <li>Establish and document team standards for AI usage, prompt patterns, code review checklists, and validation strategies.</li> <li>Contribute to a fast-paced environment, unblocking others and taking initiative where processes are still being defined.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience building highly scalable, high-performance backend applications or distributed systems.</li> <li>Background in regulated exchange or financial infrastructure strongly preferred, brokerage, futures or derivatives exchanges (e.g. CBOE, CME, ICE), market makers, or hedge funds with relevant trading infrastructure experience, or similar CFTC/SEC-regulated environments.</li> <li>Strong production experience with Java; Kotlin experience a plus.</li> <li>Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, PubSub, or similar) in a financial or high-throughput context.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data integrity and transaction management in PostgreSQL or equivalent RDBMS, including financial-grade data modelling.</li> <li>Solid grasp of software design principles (SOLID, DRY) and testing methodologies (unit, integration, end-to-end).</li> <li>Familiarity with CFTC compliance requirements, MNPI handling, and audit trail obligations in a regulated trading environment.</li> <li>Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for backend services.</li> <li>Production reliability experience: monitoring, logging, alerting, on-call, and SLO definition.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience using AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) to ship production code; able to articulate specific workflow improvements.</li> <li>Communicates complex technical concepts clearly to engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders.</li> <li>Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities evolve and decisions are made quickly.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred Qualifications:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Previous experience at a US-regulated financial exchange or licensed trading platform (e.g. CBOE, CME, or similar).</li> <li>Familiarity with low-latency trading systems, order book design, or market data infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience with low-latency in-memory systems and the performance engineering techniques required to operate them at scale.</li> <li>Experience with Aeron or similar high-performance messaging frameworks used in financial trading environments.</li> <li>Experience modernising legacy Java codebases in a financial services context.</li> <li>Previous experience in a high-growth or scale-up environment.</li> <li>Contributions to open-source projects or the technical community.</li> </ul> <p>Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE, a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connections and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.</p> <p>Ready to build the future of regulated prediction markets? If you possess some of these skills but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply! Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position. We are open to fully remote candidates based in the United Kingdom. Remote employees may also be eligible for a home office setup stipend.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p>By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our <a href="https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5ff494b9931735466ce28d5b/t/69de53bde2c02c25e9c38758/1776178110037/Candidate+Privacy+Policy+April+2026.pdf" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Policy.</a></p> <p><em>Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. description: <h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2> <p>The Customer Success team sits within DoorDash’s In-Store business and serves as a strategic partner to hospitality operators across the UK. You will act as a consultative partner to restaurant operators, helping them maximise ROI from SevenRooms while balancing retention, adoption, transaction growth, and expansion opportunities.</p> opportunities</li> <li>Build strategic success plans aligned to customer business goals and drive measurable business outcomes</li> <li>Analyze customer health, adoption, transaction trends, engagement, and ROI data to proactively identify risks and growth opportunities</li> <li>Become a product expert on SevenRooms, guiding customers through operational workflows, integrations, feature adoption, and optimization strategies</li> <li>Lead impactful business reviews and customer conversations that influence stakeholder behavior and drive action</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Account Management, Product, Support, and Marketing teams to deliver thoughtful, customer-centric solutions</li> <li>Balance strategic account planning with high-volume portfolio management in a customer impact across retention, adoption, and expansion</li> <li>You are proactive and strategic in prioritising competing customer needs</li> <li>You are comfortable influencing customers, creating measurable business outcomes and ROI</li> <li>You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments with ambiguity and changing priorities</li> <li>You are collaborative, coachable, and naturally curious</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></h2> <p>Successful CSMs at SevenRooms:</p> <ul> <li>Operate proactively and anticipate customer risks and opportunities before they surface</li> <li>Influence customers to take action and adopt best practices that drive measurable business outcomes</li> <li>Prioritize effectively across a large and diverse portfolio of growth opportunities and operational improvements</li> <li>Act as strategic partners to hospitality operators</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About DoorDash</strong></p> <p>At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started with door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known for delivering food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. </p> <p>DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.</p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. </p> <p>If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. title: Senior Software Engineer - Core Video & Data
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/hudl-2026-top-100-inspiring-workplaces?utm_medium=internal&utm_source=job-ad&utm_campaign=26_NA_talent_job-ad&utm_content=1org_learn-more_blog-link_learn-more_2blog_organic_3ctw">Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces</a>.<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&badge=0&autopause=0&player_id=0&app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p> </p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Data team in London.</p> <p>This team builds the systems that power how Hudl understands sport at scale. From identifying players and teams across thousands of leagues to processing the moments that become highlights, stats and analysis, our services sit at the center of Hudl's platform.</p> <p>As a Senior Engineer, you'll help shape the technical direction of the Global Sports Library (GSL), the backbone that connects identities, metadata and game context across Hudl products. You'll design and evolve APIs, distributed systems and large-scale data pipelines that ensure Hudl products operate from a consistent understanding of the game.</p> <p>This role is deeply backend-focused and comes with significant ownership. You'll tackle complex engineering challenges around scalability, entity resolution, data consistency and platform architecture, while helping raise the technical bar across the team through design leadership, mentoring and pragmatic decision-making.</p> <p>The systems you build won't support just one product or one sport. They'll become shared capabilities used across Hudl's ecosystem, powering experiences for teams, athletes and fans around the world.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be a key technical leader.</strong> You'll support the team by breaking down complex engineering problems, advocating for best practices and guiding others in addition to your focus on delivery.</li> <li><strong>Maintain efficiency.</strong> You'll ensure your team delivers high-impact work efficiently by focusing on outcomes over outputs. Your leadership will empower the team to make data-driven decisions and iterate quickly on feedback.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate across disciplines.</strong> You'll work closely with leaders from various disciplines to plan and deliver enhancements across our product suite. Your ability to integrate diverse perspectives will be key to driving innovation.</li> <li><strong>Foster Agile practices.</strong> You'll participate actively in Scrum ceremonies and play a significant role in maintaining a strong team culture.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Location</strong></h2> <p>Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of London. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.</p> <h2>Must-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Strong technical proficiency.</strong> You have extensive experience in full-stack engineering and have spent time with cloud-based systems and services. You're also an advocate of TDD and CI/CD.</li> <li><strong>Technical coaching experience.</strong> You're comfortable translating requirements, creating architectural proposals and guiding other engineers through implementation.</li> <li><strong>A collaborative, team-first mindset.</strong> You know building excellent software is a team effort and you're willing to pitch in whenever a teammate needs a hand.</li> <li><strong>Mentor mentality.</strong> You believe in the multiplier mindset and enjoy helping fellow engineers hone their skills through code reviews and pair programming.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice-to-Haves</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Tech stack knowledge.</strong> Professional background in C#, GraphQL, Elastic, MongoDB and AWS is ideal.</li> <li><strong>Experience with media at scale.</strong> You've worked with video encoding and on-demand rendering in a professional setting.</li> <li><strong>Passion for sports.</strong> You have an interest in the sports world and an understanding of sports analytics is a definite plus.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with hybrid teams.</strong> You've worked with hybrid or remote teams before and can adapt quickly to our working environment.</li> </ul> <h2>Our Role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Champion work-life harmony.</strong> We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.</li> <li><strong>Guarantee autonomy.</strong> We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Encourage career growth.</strong> We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.</li> <li><strong>Provide an environment to help you succeed.</strong> We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.</li> <li><strong>Support your wellbeing.</strong> Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The base salary range for this role is displayed below—<strong>starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.</strong></p> <p>We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. </p> <p>This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion. </p></div><div class="title">Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£66,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£111,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Privacy Policy</strong></h2> <p><strong><a href="https://www.hudl.com/jobs/hudl-applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Hudl Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy</span></a><br><br></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Strategic Account Manager
description: Our Mission: Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far. Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies. Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them. Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role As Omnea's Account Manager, you own the relationship with our customers across their entire lifecycle, working with some of our largest and most strategic accounts. Your job is to make sure customers get real, measurable value from Omnea from day one, and to turn that value into renewals, expansion, and upsell. Omnea's product is sticky: it's a business transformation, not a point tool, so once a customer is live, expansion tends to follow. Your focus skews heavily toward that expansion motion, not just keeping accounts renewed. You'll build deep, long-term relationships with your champions and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders at every level, from procurement managers up to CFOs. You'll be the internal voice of the customer, working closely with both technical and commercial teams to keep Omnea customer-centric at its core. This is an early hire on the customer team, working directly with Abs , Ben , and Rebe to build the function from the ground up. There's no fixed playbook yet: you'll help write it. What You'll Do Own a revenue number: You'll carry an NRR quota covering both expansion and retention across your enterprise book. That means proactively identifying upsell opportunities, running commercial conversations at exec level, and owning the renewal process end-to-end. Build relationships that go all the way to the top: Your relationships will run from procurement managers to CFOs. You'll multi-thread across each account, building genuine trust across multiple stakeholders, and you'll be the person customers call when something goes wrong or when they're thinking about what's next. Build the playbook from scratch: There's no fully built playbook yet - you'll help shape it. You'll work alongside an exceptional implementation team, product experts, and leadership that have scaled world-class companies to define the commercial rhythms, norms, and processes to set the standard as the function grows. Shape what Omnea builds next: You're the closest person to what our customers will and won't pay for. You'll feed that signal directly to Product and Revenue leadership, surfacing what's blocking adoption, what's driving expansion, and where we should be investing. What's Different About This Role This isn't a traditional post-sale account management role. Omnea's product is a business transformation, not a point tool, so most of your quota comes from expansion, not just renewal. We're not looking for a narrow "Account Manager" background. We want people from GTM roles broadly or from customer-facing roles with heavy commercial/GTM crossover. There's no fully built playbook. You'll define the commercial rhythms and processes as you go, working directly with Abs, Ben, and Rebe. You'll be as close to the product roadmap as anyone outside Product itself: what you hear from customers directly shapes what gets built next. About You We don't expect you to know exactly how to do all of this when you join. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and skillset to take this on. TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, and you instinctively know how to navigate complex organisations. You might come from a GTM role (sales, customer success, partnerships) or a customer-facing role with heavy GTM crossover. What matters is that you've worked in real enterprise environments, managed senior stakeholders with high expectations, and have a track record of getting things done. 4-8 years of experience in a top-tier, fast-paced environment: a startup, scale-up, VC, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself If you've been in a commercial role, you've worked six-figure ARR+ accounts, navigated multi-stakeholder buying committees, and built genuine executive relationships You build rapport, influence people, and drive change, whether with a distinguished exec or a junior operator. You have the gravitas to engage senior leadership, ideally up to CFOs, Legal, or Procurement You're comfortable in ambiguity. You don't need a fully built playbook: you'll build it as you go and improve it as you learn. You're organised enough to manage a complex book of business without dropping anything, and confident enough to push back on customers when they're wrong You're ambitious, competitive, and care about doing excellent work, with a track record of high performance in whatever you've turned your hand to: sales, academia, sport, or something of your own. You take ownership seriously, and you'd rather work hard on something meaningful than coast on something safe At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out. A few things to note: We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here . We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive . You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here ! We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow! Additionally, where roles have hard-specified requirements (e.g. [x] days in office, unable to provide visas, etc), if in your application you provide deterministic check-box confirmation that you do not meet the hard-specified requirements, deterministic (not AI or subjective) automatic rejection criteria are in place. title: Sr Product Manager - Virality, Referrals & KOL
description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together. The opportunity Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets. Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business. Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys. Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships. Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams. Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment. Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers. Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale. What you bring You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers. Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted. Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate. Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models. Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs. Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try. Nice to haves Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts. Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls. Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. </p> <p>For more information, please visit <a href="http://www.vml.com/" data-outlook-id="d4b7d1c3-8ad6-4b6d-ab45-d3cb5a3aebe1">www.vml.com </a>and follow along on <a href="https://urldefense.proofpoint.com/v2/url?u=https-3A__urldefense.com_v3_-5F-5Fhttps-3A_www.linkedin.com_company_vml_-5F-5F-3B-21-21JboVxjCXSME-21OhlpCfbkl1UcWPwns1-2DGtvHOzFh0QwHV49fsPgGw-2DVCCU1bCg8aQFI9vN-2Dy-2DVwaQcITH2j2XKzGKBIFRLYf2AUWVYY1dFGK6-24&d=DwMFaQ&c=euGZstcaTDllvimEN8b7jXrwqOf-v5A_CdpgnVfiiMM&r=zouFnm4jZMgDFaYF1uVcRY3rbgHWPca_luUrBUkT6Yc&m=QzcCgXCAOjzj5hiU48_CKOdHRSJ4_YpuqfviT9yjlzH5VrkzySTZ-WaQXlYAnj4W&s=jJ7q5V70u9oUx7ONPm5jC3IK8y6vxDilX6BGTlqlWlA&e=" data-outlook-id="a3ef68bf-16fb-4ebc-9ca9-406007d6cefc">LinkedIn</a> #WeAreVML.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Who we’re looking for:</strong></span></p> <p>VML is seeking a Data Planning Director to be a trusted partner to our clients, navigating their business, understanding their challenges and connecting across VML, as well as WPP at large, to ensure we are setup to deliver success with world-class services and solutions.</p> <p>This role is part of an integrated Data & Analytics team across measurement & reporting, predictive modelling, data strategy solutions, covering media, CX, CRM and more. The focus is to act as the glue between clients, WPP teams on all things data. As such, you will need to organise, motivate and inspire to connect all (data and non-data) disciplines in delivering success for our clients. Gravitas and strong collaboration are essential.</p> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Team direction and oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct a team of data, technology and business consultants, analysts and engineers, overseeing client briefs and managing team workload.</li> <li>Direct and motivate the team to help them achieve their goals and deliver brilliant work for VML’s clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data & Analytics leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as strategic partner and advisor, helping clients to leverage the power of data, martech, analytics and AI to achieve their goals and drive effectiveness and efficiency.</li> <li>Develop proposals and methodologies for <ul> <li>Data Planning; encompassing data-driven journey design, targeting personalisation, test and learn</li> <li>Analytics & Data Science solutions; encompassing customer analytics (e.g. customer segmentation, predictive modelling), digital analytics (e.g. journey analysis, web/app, media analysis), business intelligence (e.g. dashboard reporting) and AI (e.g. conversational BI)</li> <li>Data & Analytics consulting; encompassing data, marketing technology, AI and operations (process, skills, culture, business change etc.). Includes data, AI, martech and adtech transformation roadmaps, measurement frameworks and associated operating model development.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Inspire our clients and all of VML with thought-leadership and best practice.</li> <li>Work closely with our clients to help diagnose and solve their challenges, support their data & AI vision, and make it happen.</li> <li>Drive client success and satisfaction in all you do.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>New business – be a data and analytics lead for pitches to deliver winning proposals and presentations.</li> <li>New & Organic business – be relentless at bringing new ideas and opportunities to grow our existing clients and bring our data offer to clients who work with us in other disciplines.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you’ll need:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional experience leading across data and analytics in a consulting/agency environment, setting up teams and operating models with clients</li> <li>A belief in the value of data-driven marketing & AI to deliver exceptional results.</li> <li>Experience of building relationships with clients from junior to C-suite and dealing with the different and complex personalities involved.</li> <li>Someone who can unify groups from across a wide skill set and unify them behind a clear brief or goal and deliver excellent work for clients.</li> <li>A candidate with the ability to engage people with their presentation skills but show excellent active listening to create clear actions which meet client needs.</li> <li>A person with a love for data-driven marketing and is constantly following trends to develop impactful and significant work for our clients.</li> <li>Significant experience at scoping, resourcing, and developing commercial proposals.</li> <li>Knowledge of data and analytics technologies across the marketing and digital ecosystem including media, commerce, social and digital platforms, CRM & loyalty</li> <li>Knowledge of analytics solutions and how AI can be leveraged in marketing to drive growth.</li> <li>Must have knowledge (you need not be a deep practitioner in all these areas, but do need have a good appreciation across them): <ul> <li>Data strategy consulting – data landscape (1<sup>st</sup>, 2<sup>nd</sup>, 3<sup>rd</sup> party data), data management, governance, roadmap and use case development</li> <li>Analytics & AI – segmentation, predictive modelling, measurement & reporting, AI marketing applications and product development</li> <li>Marketing technologies – data cloud solutions, clean rooms, analytics and reporting tools, CDPs, CRM / marketing automation, AI technologies</li> <li>Marketing operations – operating models, process design, governance, data culture and skills development, client enablement and business change</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p>At VML, we are committed to fostering an all-inclusive work environment that is both rewarding and career-forward. Our Inclusion, Equity & Belonging initiatives, alongside the VML Foundation, reflect our dedication to giving back and making a positive impact in our communities and beyond. Our people are the heartbeat of our organization—creators, doers, innovators, makers, and thinkers—who drive not just marketing, but meaningful experiences that resonate in every action and interaction. </p> <p>VML is a WPP Agency. For more information, please visit <a href="http://www.vml.com/">our website</a>, and follow VML on our social channels via <a href="https://www.instagram.com/vml_global/">Instagram</a>, <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/vmlyr/">LinkedIn</a>, and <a href="https://twitter.com/vml_global">X</a><u>.</u> </p> <p>When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to VML. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our <a href="https://www.vml.com/recruitment-privacy-policy">Recruitment Privacy Policy</a>. California residents should read our <a href="https://www.vml.com/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice</a>. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.</p> <p><strong>Who we are:</strong></p> <p>At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse. </p> <p>Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences.  Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, offering deep insights in communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, and technology. We deliver end-to-end solutions that result in revolutionary work. </p> <p> </p> <p><strong> </strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB"><span lang="EN-GB">We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</span></span></span></p> <p><span class="normaltextrun"><span lang="EN-GB">WPP (VML) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. Reporting into a data planning manager, the team is part of the wider EMEA Data team. This has a mix of consultants, analysts, data scientists, insight and effectiveness experts, as well as a team of technical enablement specialists. </p> <p><strong>Who we’re looking for:</strong><br>We're seeking a highly collaborative and enthusiastic Data Planner to join our team to work on a large automotive account. You will be a key data evangelist, working with clients and internal teams to develop and deliver data-driven strategies focused on CRM targeting, personalisation, measurement, and optimisation. </p> <p><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong><br>As a Data Planner, you will be a crucial link between data analysis and broader marketing strategy, developing connected, data-inspired CRM programs. This involves:<br>•    Building strong relationships with client stakeholders and internal VML teams to promote, develop, and manage data and analysis deliverables.<br>•    Analysing campaigns to develop actionable insights.<br>•    Defining KPIs, benchmarks, targets, and forecasts.<br>•    Developing campaign targeting plans and briefs for internal or 3rd party campaign delivery teams.<br>•    Measuring, evaluating, and optimising marketing activity using best practice testing methodologies.<br>•    Presenting regularly to clients and attending client meetings.<br>•    Driving strategy across all channels and touchpoints, from email, push, and SMS to a connected communications plan encompassing digital media, including social, mobile, and website.<br>•    Working closely with analysts, strategists, account and campaign delivery teams, and multiple client stakeholders.</p> <p><strong>What Skills Will Help You Be Successful:</strong><br>•    2+ years of experience in a data function, preferably within an agency environment or a similar role with transferable skills.<br>•    Strong understanding of CRM principles and digital marketing landscape<br>•    Proven ability to manage your own projects and work effectively within cross-functional teams.<br>•    Excellent communication, organization, proposal writing, and presentation skills.<br>•    Ability to explain complex technical data concepts in a clear and concise manner to non-technical audiences.<br>•    Strategic thinking and analytical skills, with a high level of numeracy.<br>•    Proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools.<br>•    A proactive, curious, and collaborative approach, with a willingness to learn and push boundaries.<br>•    A passion for data and its potential to drive business impact.</p> <p><strong>Nice to have’s:</strong><br>o    Familiarity with marketing automation platforms, CDPs, and ESPs, especially Salesforce Marketing Cloud.<br>o    Experience with website analytics and personalisation/testing tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics & Target).<br>o    Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is beneficial.</p>
